gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hind-madurai: Handwritten ease from Delius Unicase, with no tapering at the stroke ends. Hind Madurai, a plain sans with s curves open wide at both ends, settles the page below it.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru is a sans with lowercase pressing close to ascender height. Delius Unicase, handwritten and relaxed with untapered strokes, leads the way, and the sans follows with tidy, modern lines.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hind-siliguri: Rope-ladder rhythm, friendly and hand-drawn. Delius Unicase does best at charm, with relaxed untapered letters, while Hind Siliguri does best at a quiet, constant hum, its sans rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-hind-vadodara: Hand-lettered and easygoing, Delius Unicase brings a tall x-height and ropey spacing above Hind Vadodara, a sans with spacious terminal gaps. Paragraphs of it read smooth, clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-huninn: Strokes that never taper define Delius Unicase, while Huninn, a plain sans, lifts its lowercase close to cap height. Shrink the heading and that rope-ladder spacing loses its charm.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-inter-tight: Untapered strokes give Delius Unicase its relaxed look, while Inter Tight, a sans-serif, tucks its curve tails well back. One feels handwritten and loose, the other tightly drawn and modern.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-julius-sans-one: Handwritten ease, no tapering anywhere, from Delius Unicase. Julius Sans One, a sans with capitals and lowercase nearly matched in height and generous gaps between letters, reads light and spaced over long text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-kadwa: Relaxed, hand-drawn letters in Delius Unicase hold every stroke at a single tube-like thickness. And Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and its own tall x-height, adds a classic editorial voice.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-karla: Neon-tube steadiness meets hand-lettered ease: Delius Unicase keeps every stroke alike, while Karla, a sans-serif, gapes open at the c. Long stretches of Karla feel stocky, solid and quietly easygoing.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-kedebideri: Uniform, hand-lettered charm comes from Delius Unicase, with no swelling or thinning anywhere. And Kedebideri, a plain sans with a skyward x-height, is happiest when the heading gets a little more size.
